set.rappels: Rappel the route on a single 80 m rope. The route is 10 pitches and 1,100 ft; no count of rappel stations is published.
set.rappel_count_note: The only published descent beta is to rappel the route on a single 80 m rope, so no station list is given here. The alternative is about 150 m of 4th-class terrain to the true summit and the standard Liberty Bell descent: a rappel off slung trees and two bolted rappels of about 25 m into the Liberty Bell-Concord notch.
set.descent: Rappel the route on a single 80 m rope, or continue about 150 m of 4th-class terrain to the true summit and take the standard Liberty Bell descent.
set.descent_text: Two descent options exist. Most parties rappel the route itself on a single 80 m rope, back down the 1,100 ft face to the base and their packs; bring the 80 m, since shorter ropes are not described as reaching. Alternatively, continue about 150 m of 4th-class terrain to Liberty Bell’s true summit and take the standard descent: from the summit, go east to a tree hung with rappel slings, make one single-rope rappel to a sandy ledge, then two single-rope rappels of about 25 m from bolted anchors into the Liberty Bell-Concord notch. That leaves you on the opposite side of the mountain from the East Face approach.
